title: Causal cadence
description: A white point crosses a black strip while a caption follows either its departure or its arrival.
useCase: Specify whether a secondary animation should follow the start or the completion of an earlier action.
interaction: Choose Departure or Arrival to start a sequence, then replay or pause it. Compare the displayed cue times.
reducedMotion: Play and mode changes immediately display the final point and caption together with their event timestamps.
limitations: An authored two-event sequence, not a timeline editor or dependency scheduler. Timing controls are captured on the next Play or mode selection; travel distance updates live.
look: A large white point and a two-line white caption occupy a black strip on salmon, above a thin time rail and spare native sequence controls.
motion: Play moves the point with a cubic ease-out. In Departure mode the caption begins after the chosen delay from zero; in Arrival mode it begins after travel completes plus that delay. Host pause and hidden documents freeze elapsed time.
adapt: `cueAt` derives the caption start from the selected `mode`, `travelDuration`, and `captionOffset`; `paint` maps elapsed time to point position and caption opacity. Replace the caption artwork, and tune `travelDuration`, `captionDuration`, or `travelDistance` for your sequence.
